verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents double-entry bookkeeping on a chart of accounts and lets users assign invoices and receipts to cost centres, which is a class-style dimension for filtering and analysis. Nothing in the evidence shows that accountants can customize the chart of accounts itself. missing for 10: ability to add or edit accounts, account type configuration, sub-account hierarchy, tag dimensions beyond cost centres, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions

citations.quote: Double-entry bookkeeping is carried out using a chart of accounts.
Assign invoices and receipts to different cost centres. You can then filter by cost centre and analyse the income and expenses assigned to each one.
